pc_execution: functions.exec V8 new Function(page,helper,sharedFixturePrefix+check_console_test.js). Actual PAGE extracted from saved C initializer; no board connection/build/flash.
purpose: A previously valid ARM ticket from the same test session is submitted only after its advertised remaining TTL plus 100 ms. The obsolete request must not ARM the STM.
steps: Refresh normal robot page; READY / IDLE / fresh DISARMED and all zero required.
Paste console_test.js once; installation only sends HELLO. Wait for AC-S04 READY.
Start LA D0/D1 UART plus D4/D6/D7 capture at 4 MHz, 100M samples / 25 seconds.
Manually execute ur03Acs04.start() in Console. Do not click page ARM.
Expected TICKET_REJECTED, 1 second fresh IDLE/DISARMED observation, APP_CHECKS_OK_CAPTURE_REQUIRED.
Save a unique 2026-10-16_UR03_ACS04_EXPIRED_ARM_PWM_run01.sr; paste copy(ur03Acs04.report()) result.
constraints: No firmware edit or build; no new wiring.
Existing zero-only bench: motor B+ and board power plugs remain disconnected as previously confirmed.
No CMD and no ARM retry; one manual start per page; cancel discards unsent request.
Unexpected acceptance, changed identity/state/output/counters or missing response makes result INCOMPLETE; post-send failure attempts DISARM.
Capture must confirm no ARM/CMD on D1, DISARMED/zero TEL on D0, D4/PB6 and D7/PB7 LOW, D6/PC7 LOW.
limits: This covers the expired/obsolete ARM ticket subcase only, not all AC-S04.
Periodic snapshots may replace the expired ticket ID before submission. TICKET_REJECTED alone cannot isolate the EXPIRED branch from MISMATCH after replacement; helper logs current and frozen IDs.
No exact 149/150 ms boundary, selective ACK loss/delay, late UART ACK, CMD-only watchdog recovery, RF loss or powered-motor stopping claim.
Firmware source identity checked; flashed binary readback is not available.
next_action: No repeat of this passed subcase. Preserve overall AC-S04 as partial; selective ACK delay/loss and late replies need separate evidence.
